verdict.rationale: Workflow versioning and dev-to-prod promotion is a fair question for a workflow automation platform like Zapier, but the evidence pack never documents Zap versioning, source-control sync, environments, or promotion. The Platform CLI and Visual Builder cover building integrations for the App Directory, not versioning or promoting user workflows, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version workflows through source control or environments and promote changes from dev to production
